description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM -FRONT- bumper connecter brackets.
These brackets bolt to the front frame.
Once attached to the frame then the bumper is bolted to these brackets.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – LH Front Bumper Bracket
Qty 1 – RH Front Bumper Bracket
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
